MEET THE ARTIST / 김뜻돌

Meaningful Stone

Meaningful Stone (김뜻돌) writes songs from remembered dreams and personal relationships. In a Genie interview, she described wanting to record the atmosphere that lingered between dreams and waking life.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-11-12

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESBeep-Boop, Beep-Boop ↗Psychomania ↗

She debuted in 2017 with the single 꿈속의 카메라 and released her first full-length album, A Call from My Dream, in 2020. She won Rookie of the Year at the 2021 Korean Music Awards.

INDIE ROCK / 2020

Beep-Boop, Beep-Boop삐뽀삐뽀

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

A falling construction crane makes the possibility of sudden death concrete in “Beep-Boop, Beep-Boop”. The speaker asks why attention should arrive only after someone disappears.

Lyrics by Meaningful Stone; music by Meaningful Stone; arranged by Meaningful Stone, Onewoo Kang, Park Mun-chi (박문치), Kang Jeon-ho (강전호) and Han Je-ri (한제리).

ALTERNATIVE ROCK / 2022

Psychomania

Official music video

View release on Apple Music ↗

The release note for “Psychomania” stages an encounter with a fierce inner voice. Their conversation moves through anger, the need to keep living and an unsettling request for a prayer.

A little background

“Psychomania - Single” was released on October 29, 2022. Meaningful Stone wrote and produced the song, and the official credits name MELTMIRROR as the music video’s director.

Lyrics by Meaningful Stone; music by Meaningful Stone; arranged by Meaningful Stone, Onewoo Kang, EJae and Nahyun Kim; produced by Meaningful Stone.
